svg.title: Ainekio ESP32-P4-WIFI6 to XIITIA 1.9-inch ST7789 LCD pinout and wiring
svg.desc: P4 component-side view with USB-C at top. Right header R5 supplies LCD VCC and BLK at 3.3 volts. R6 GPIO20 goes to SCL, R7 GPIO21 to SDA, R8 ground to GND, R9 GPIO22 to CS, R10 GPIO23 to DC, and R12 GPIO26 to RES. The LCD front view shows its eight printed pins in order GND VCC SCL SDA RES DC CS BLK. Disconnect power while wiring.
svg.text: XIITIA ST7789 · 320 × 170 LANDSCAPE · GPIO / SPI CONNECTION
Remove power before wiring. Match the printed labels on your delivered boards.
Front / component side · USB-C at top
Count downward from the USB-C end.
Screen facing you · eight solder pads at the top
Printed pad order, viewed from the screen side
ONE 3.3 V SUPPLY → TWO LCD CONNECTIONS
Split the 3V3 connection to VCC and BLK.
BLK is the backlight input; it stays on.
Do not use the 5 V servo-power feed.
SCL / SDA ON THIS LCD ARE SPI SIGNALS
Use GPIO20 / GPIO21 — not the P4 pins labeled SDA / SCL for its onboard I²C bus.
LCD RES connects to GPIO26. Leave P4 RUN / reset alone.
Use the GPIO header. The P4 display ribbon connector is a different interface.
2026-10-06 · Firmware 0.8.0-p4-color-face · Full instructions: LCD_FACE.md · Board illustrations are schematic, not to scale.
